rooms.name: flagstone corridor
rooms.description: You are standing in a well kept flagstone corridor. The stonework here is of the finest quality, and certain of the stones are engraved with a luniform design. There is a jagged hole in the ceiling, and rubble litters the floor. The corridor leads to the south.
